[cols="2h,5,5,5,5,5",options="header"]
|===
|Name |`random_device` |`equal` |`error` |`pem` |`openssl_memory_resource`

|What it is for
|Keys, IVs, tokens, nonces: every secret a program draws
|Checking a tag, a MAC or a token
|Telling failures apart
|A key's SPKI or PKCS#8 as text, to paste, store or exchange with OpenSSL
|Keeping every allocation of OpenSSL's in the program's own resource, natively

|Header
|`<webcpp/crypto/random_device.hpp>`
|`<webcpp/crypto/equal.hpp>`
|`<webcpp/crypto/error.hpp>`
|`<webcpp/crypto/pem.hpp>`
|`<webcpp/crypto/backends/openssl.hpp>`

|Errors
|`entropy_unavailable`, `errc::not_supported`
|none: it returns `bool`
|its values are the errors
|`invalid_encoding`, `invalid_input_size`
|`memory_functions_refused`, `memory_functions_not_installed`

|Standards and sources
|link:https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9799919799/functions/getentropy.html[POSIX.1-2024, getentropy], link:https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/bcrypt/nf-bcrypt-bcryptgenrandom[Microsoft, BCryptGenRandom], link:https://www.w3.org/TR/WebCryptoAPI/#Crypto-method-getRandomValues[W3C Web Cryptography API, getRandomValues], link:https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-random[WASI, wasi:random]
|link:https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/208.html[CWE-208, observable timing discrepancy]
|none
|link:https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7468[RFC 7468, textual encodings of PKIX, PKCS and CMS structures (PEM)], link:https://doc.libsodium.org/helpers#base64-encoding-decoding[libsodium's documentation, helpers: base64 encoding and decoding]
|link:https://docs.openssl.org/3.5/man3/OPENSSL_malloc/[OpenSSL 3.5's OPENSSL_malloc(3), CRYPTO_set_mem_functions]

|Choose it when
|you need a random number an attacker must not predict; never `std::mt19937` or `rand` (link:https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/338.html[CWE-338, a weak generator used for security])
|you compare anything secret; never `==` or `memcmp` on a MAC
|you branch on a failure: forged data, a wrong size, no entropy
|a key goes to or comes from a file, a form or a tool as `-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----` text; with the `encode_spki` and `encode_pkcs8` of `curves::ed25519`, `curves::x25519` or `curves::secp256k1`
|a native program on OpenSSL must allocate only from its own arena; on WebAssembly, BearSSL allocates nothing
